info.title: joehub public read API
info.description: Synthetic contract shared by the Next.js route handlers and the optional FastAPI process. Paths are /api/... on both origins. On the Next.js origin, /finance/accounts without the /api prefix is the UI page and returns HTML, not this contract. Finance, jobs, and journal routes are read-only fixtures. POST /api/tasks creates one unfinished task and honors an Idempotency-Key for about 24 hours. No raw SQL, file download, or export. The browser authenticates with the joehub_session cookie.

servers.description: Next.js route handlers on the site origin. Request /api/finance/accounts on this origin. A request to /finance/accounts is the UI shell and returns HTML.
Optional FastAPI process on its own origin. The same /api paths are served there. No extra host is required to run the synthetic shell, and this process is not deployed.

get.description: Unfinished tasks (status other than Done), including undated ones, newest first by createdAt.

post.description: Create one task. Title is required. notes, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD, America/Detroit), priority (High, Medium, Low), project, and status (To do, Doing, or Blocked; default To do) are optional. Done is rejected. The same Idempotency-Key replays this response for about 24 hours.

201.description: Created task, or the task already stored for this Idempotency-Key

post.description: Dev-only fake login. Refused in production.

200.description: Revokes the device and its session

sessionCookie.name: joehub_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session id. Expiry is stored server-side for 14 days and does not roll.
